Board kept the regular dividend rate on SATA Stock at 13.00% effective for periods on/after October 1, 2026.
Declared daily cash dividends of $0.0516 per SATA share for each business day Oct 1–31, 2026 (21 business days).
Aggregate monthly dividend equals $1.0836 per share for October, with daily payments to holders of record as of prior business day close.
Company states distributions may be treated as return of capital for U.S. tax purposes and expects no current or accumulated earnings and profits.
